name: Product Photos by RunComfy
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Product Photos by RunComfy turns existing product photos into clean studio images, lifestyle scenes and campaign variants using compatible image models.

What you can do:
• Create a clean product image with a white or studio background.
• Place a product into a described lifestyle setting.
• Prepare a requested set of images for different scenes or formats.
• Define the product color, shape, label and material details to check against the original.

Connect a RunComfy account to generate images. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Model choices and available dimensions depend on the current catalog.

Provide a product photo through an accessible HTTPS link. The plugin asks for a usable link if a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model. AI edits can change labels, geometry and fine details, so compare every result with the original before commercial use. A white background does not imply a transparent cutout. The plugin does not automatically publish images to an online store.
